ValuesTest#FilterExistsExternalValuesCla.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Query §18.2.4.3 (P := Join(P, ToMultiSet(data)) for a trailing VALUES, after the WHERE pattern) and §18.6 (EXISTS substitutes the current solution, which does not bind ?o)
ValuesTest#FilterExistsExternalValuesCla.note: RDF4J (GH-1026) treats the trailing VALUES as an initial binding of ?o visible inside FILTER EXISTS, giving 1 row; by the algebra ?o is unbound when EXISTS is evaluated, both subjects pass, and the join with ?o=<http://obj1> keeps both: the engine's 2 rows are the specification's answer.
